name: Account Access Errors
description: Customers report being unable to access their accounts and seeing an unclear missing-token message.

name: Login and Password Failures
description: Customers cannot log in, and some report that their phone numbers or passwords are rejected.

name: Basic Features Behind Premium
description: Customers say features such as lyrics and better audio quality require Premium, with repeated prompts limiting basic use.

name: Charges for Listening and Replay
description: A customer objects to charges for listening to or replaying music.

name: Mixed Billing and Access Complaints
description: Examples combine complaints about cost and Premium lyrics with unrelated access and feature availability issues.

name: Unable to Purchase Individual Premium
description: A customer cannot complete an individual Premium signup because selecting the plan does not show a payment prompt.

name: Playback Controls Require Premium
description: Customers say choosing songs, skipping, or advancing playback is restricted without Premium, and one reports a blank subscription page.

name: Complaints About Premium Costs
description: Customers object to the app putting music and other features behind payment and express dissatisfaction with its focus on money.

name: Missing and Unsuitable Music
description: Customers report missing songs, limited genres, repetitive DJ selections, short clips, and recommendations they dislike.

name: Lyrics Missing or Poorly Displayed
description: Customers say lyrics are unavailable or fail to load for some songs, and one dislikes the updated lyric font.

name: Unwanted Playlist Recommendations
description: Customers report receiving playlist recommendations despite turning them off and express dissatisfaction with music updates.

name: Downloaded Music Disappeared
description: Customers report that downloaded content or saved items disappeared, including after a storage move.

name: Download and Offline Access Problems
description: Customers report failed or stalled downloads and difficulty accessing music offline or downloading it without payment.

name: Offline Playback Not Working
description: A customer reports that offline playback does not work.

name: Mixed Generic App Complaints
description: Examples include a Wrap screen that will not open, missing features, and general dissatisfaction without a consistent specific defect.

name: Podcast Playback Lag
description: A customer reports that some podcasts have started lagging.

name: Internet Connection Errors
description: Customers report connection errors or loading failures despite having a working internet connection.

name: App Crashes and Loading Failures
description: Customers report crashes, black or loading screens, and playback stopping unexpectedly.

name: Difficulty Connecting Other Devices
description: A customer says connecting the app to other devices is difficult.

name: General Playback Failures
description: Customers report that music does not play or advance properly and that playback-related features or connections fail.

name: Unexpected or Incorrect Songs
description: Customers say playback switches to unexpected songs or plays a song they did not select.

name: Playback Pauses or Stops Randomly
description: Customers report songs and podcasts pausing or stopping unexpectedly during playback.

name: Music Will Not Play
description: Customers say the app will not play songs or any music.

name: Excessive and Unskippable Ads
description: Customers complain about frequent, long, or unskippable ads interrupting music and replacing songs.

name: Mixed Usability and Feature Complaints
description: Examples describe difficulty using the app, unwanted automatic starts, podcast controls, and inconsistent comments about ads and listening.

name: Library and Playlist Controls Fail
description: Customers report trouble viewing saved songs, finding playlists, adding tracks to the queue, and controlling playlist playback.

name: Confusing Interface and Removed Features
description: Customers say updates make navigation harder, change familiar controls, or remove features and settings.

name: Shuffle and Skip Restrictions
description: Customers report unwanted shuffle, difficulty controlling it, and limits on skipping, repeating, or selecting playback points.
